units: every L_s, r and Delta is built from SQUARED relative discrepancies; the unsquared ratio is sqrt(r)

reporting_symbol.note: the main text and the Supplementary write N = 400 and N_vis = 12000. B_gen and B_VIS are internal code field names only; the symbol B must not appear in prose, tables, figures or captions.

notes: all 20 checkpoints were evaluated once, irrespective of validation success
the two endpoint ratios use window-specific denominators and do not classify runs
Delta_s is descriptive, is not a non-inferiority test and has no pass/fail threshold
the long-lag statistic and the sliding-window figure are descriptive and do not alter the accepted mask
no checkpoint was reselected and no run was reclassified here
